# Copilot Instructions for Gautham G Rao Portfolio

This is a Next.js portfolio website showcasing cloud and AI expertise. When working with this codebase:

## Project Context

- Personal portfolio for Gautham G Rao, a Cloud Specialist & AI Engineer
- Built with Next.js 14, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS
- Focus on showcasing AI/ML projects, cloud architecture, and technical skills
- Professional, modern design with interactive elements

## Code Style Guidelines

- Use TypeScript for all components and pages
- Follow Next.js App Router conventions
- Use Tailwind CSS for styling with custom gradients and animations
- Implement responsive design for all components
- Use semantic HTML and accessibility best practices

## Component Structure

- Create reusable components in `/src/components`
- Use proper TypeScript interfaces for props
- Implement proper error handling and loading states
- Follow React best practices with hooks and state management

## Content Guidelines

- Maintain professional tone reflecting cloud and AI expertise
- Include relevant technical details and project outcomes
- Use industry-standard terminology for cloud and AI concepts
- Ensure all content aligns with the personal brand as a Cloud Specialist & AI Engineer

## Performance Considerations

- Optimize images and assets
- Use Next.js built-in optimization features
- Implement proper SEO metadata
- Ensure fast loading times and smooth animations
